title: अष्टादशाधिकत्रिशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Narada says that when pleasure and pain are reversed, neither wisdom nor effort saves a man, and speaks of the body consumed by another body like a boat laid on a boat. Shuka, freed from attachment, fixes his mind on liberation and leaves his father to go.
summary.kn: ಸುಖ-ದುಃಖ ಉಲ್ಟಾ ಆದಾಗ ಬುದ್ಧಿ, ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ರಕ್ಷಿಸುವುದಿಲ್ಲ, ದೇಹ ದೋಣಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ದೋಣಿ ಇಟ್ಟಂತೆ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ದೇಹದಿಂದ ಸುಡಲ್ಪಡುತ್ತದೆಂದು ನಾರದ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಆಸಕ್ತಿ ಮುಕ್ತ ಶುಕ ಮೋಕ್ಷದಲ್ಲಿ ಮನಸ್ಸಿಟ್ಟು ತಂದೆಯನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಹೊರಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: नारद कहते हैं कि सुख-दुःख के उलट जाने पर न प्रज्ञा न पुरुषार्थ बचाता है, और देह की तुलना दूसरे देह द्वारा जलाई जाने वाली नाव पर रखी नाव से करते हैं। आसक्ति से मुक्त शुक मोक्ष में मन लगाकर पिता को छोड़कर चल पड़ते हैं।
summary.te: సుఖదుఃఖాలు తారుమారైనప్పుడు ప్రజ్ఞ, ప్రయత్నం రక్షించవని, దేహం పడవపై పెట్టిన పడవలా మరో దేహంతో దహింపబడుతుందని నారదుడు చెబుతాడు. ఆసక్తి విడిచిన శుకుడు మోక్షంపై మనసు నిలిపి తండ్రిని విడిచి వెళ్తాడు.
summary.ta: இன்பமும் துன்பமும் மாறும்போது அறிவோ முயற்சியோ காக்காது, உடல் படகின்மேல் படகு வைத்தது போல் மற்றோர் உடலால் எரிக்கப்படுகிறது என்று நாரதர் கூறுகிறார். பற்றற்ற சுகர் விடுதலையில் மனம் வைத்துத் தந்தையை விட்டுச் செல்கிறார்.
summary.ml: സുഖവും ദുഃഖവും മാറിമറിയുമ്പോൾ ജ്ഞാനമോ പരിശ്രമമോ മനുഷ്യനെ രക്ഷിക്കുന്നില്ലെന്ന് നാരദൻ പറയുന്നു; ഒരു തോണി മറ്റൊരു തോണിയിൽ വെച്ചതുപോലെ ഒരു ശരീരം മറ്റൊന്നിനാൽ നശിപ്പിക്കപ്പെടുന്നതിനെക്കുറിച്ചും അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു. ആസക്തിയില്ലാതായ ശുകൻ മോക്ഷത്തിൽ മനസ്സുറപ്പിച്ച് പിതാവിനെ വിട്ടുപോകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 12.318; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Jun 16 2021

verses.text: नारद उवाच

meaning.en: Narada said:

verses.text:
सुखदुःखविपर्यासो यदा समुपपद्यते ।
नैनं प्रज्ञा सुनीतं वा त्रायते नापि पौरुषम् ॥

meaning.en: When a reversal of pleasure and pain comes, neither wisdom, nor sound guidance, nor manly effort can save a man from it.

verses.text:
स्वभावाद्यत्नमातिष्ठेद्यत्नवान्नावसीदति ।
जरामरणरोगेभ्यः प्रियमात्मानमुद्धरेत् ॥

meaning.en: By nature one should make effort; the one who strives does not sink. One should rescue one's dear self from old age, death, and disease.

verses.text:
रुजन्ति हि शरीराणि रोगाः शारीरमानसाः ।
सायका इव तीक्ष्णाग्राः प्रयुक्ता दृढधन्विभिः ॥

meaning.en: Diseases of body and mind torment bodies like sharp-pointed arrows shot by strong archers.

verses.text:
व्याधितस्य विवित्साभिस्त्रस्यतो जीवितैषिणः ।
अवशस्य विनाशाय शरीरमपकृष्यते ॥

meaning.en: For a sick man, anxious and frightened, wanting life and desperately seeking cures, the body is dragged toward its destruction against his will.

verses.text:
स्रवन्ति न निवर्तन्ते स्रोतांसि सरितामिव ।
आयुरादाय मर्त्यानां रात्र्यहानि पुनः पुनः ॥

meaning.en: The nights and days take away the lives of mortals again and again, flowing on and not returning, like the currents of rivers.

verses.text:
व्यत्ययो ह्ययमत्यन्तं पक्षयोः शुक्लकृष्णयोः ।
जातं मर्त्यं जरयति निमेषं नावतिष्ठते ॥

meaning.en: This alternation of the bright and dark fortnights is relentless; it ages the mortal born and does not stop for a blink.

verses.text:
सुखदुःखानि भूतानामजरो जरयन्नसौ ।
आदित्यो ह्यस्तमभ्येति पुनः पुनरुदेति च ॥

meaning.en: The sun, ageless, ages the pleasures and pains of beings; it sets and rises again and again.

verses.text:
अदृष्टपूर्वानादाय भावानपरिशङ्कितान् ।
इष्टानिष्टान्मनुष्याणामस्तं गच्छन्ति रात्रयः ॥

meaning.en: Bringing things never seen before and unsuspected, welcome and unwelcome to humans, the nights go to their setting.

verses.text:
यो यमिच्छेद्यथाकामं कामानां तत्तदाप्नुयात् ।
यदि स्यान्न पराधीनं पुरुषस्य क्रियाफलम् ॥

meaning.en: A man would gain whatever he wished, as he wished, if the fruit of a person's action were not subject to another.

verses.text:
संयताश्च हि दक्षाश्च मतिमन्तश्च मानवाः ।
दृश्यन्ते निष्फलाः सन्तः प्रहीणाश्च स्वकर्मभिः ॥

meaning.en: Yet we see people who are disciplined, skilled, and intelligent remain unfruitful, ruined by their own deeds.

verses.text:
अपरे बालिशाः सन्तो निर्गुणाः पुरुषाधमाः ।
आशीर्भिरप्यसंयुक्ता दृश्यन्ते सर्वकामिनः ॥

meaning.en: Others, who are foolish, worthless, and the lowest of men, are seen with all their desires fulfilled even without prayers.

verses.text:
भूतानामपरः कश्चिद्धिंसायां सततोत्थितः ।
वञ्चनायां च लोकस्य स सुखेष्वेव जीर्यते ॥

meaning.en: Another sort, constantly active in harming creatures and in cheating the world, grows old amid pleasures alone.

verses.text:
अचेष्टमानमासीनं श्रीः कंचिदुपतिष्ठति ।
कश्चित्कर्मानुसृत्यान्यो न प्राप्यमधिगच्छति ॥

meaning.en: Fortune comes to sit by some who make no effort; another follows his action and still does not get what he should.

verses.text:
अपराधं समाचक्ष्व पुरुषस्य स्वभावतः ।
शुक्रमन्यत्र संभूतं पुनरन्यत्र गच्छति ॥

meaning.en: Tell me the fault in man's nature: seed produced in one place goes again to another.

verses.text:
तस्य योनौ प्रसक्तस्य गर्भो भवति वा न वा ।
आम्रपुष्पोपमा यस्य निवृत्तिरुपलभ्यते ॥

meaning.en: When one is attached to the womb, a conception may occur or not; for some, the outcome is like a mango blossom that fails to bear fruit.

verses.text:
केषांचित्पुत्रकामानामनुसंतानमिच्छताम् ।
सिद्धौ प्रयतमानानां नैवाण्डमुपजायते ॥

meaning.en: Some who desire sons and wish for lineage and strive for success never get even an egg.

verses.text:
गर्भाच्चोद्विजमानानां क्रुद्धादाशीविषादिव ।
आयुष्माञ्जायते पुत्रः कथं प्रेतः पितैव सः ॥

meaning.en: Some, shrinking from the womb as from an angry snake, still have a son born who lives long; yet how is the father himself like one dead?

verses.text:
देवानिष्ट्वा तपस्तप्त्वा कृपणैः पुत्रगृद्धिभिः ।
दश मासान्परिधृता जायन्ते कुलपांसनाः ॥

meaning.en: Pitiable men greedy for sons honor the gods and perform austerities, yet the sons carried ten months are born as disgraces to the family.

verses.text:
अपरे धनधान्यानि भोगांश्च पितृसंचितान् ।
विपुलानभिजायन्ते लब्धास्तैरेव मङ्गलैः ॥

meaning.en: Others are born to vast wealth, grain, and pleasures amassed by their fathers, as if obtained through those very blessings.

verses.text:
अन्योन्यं समभिप्रेत्य मैथुनस्य समागमे ।
उपद्रव इवाविष्टो योनिं गर्भः प्रपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: Out of mutual desire in the union of the sexes, the embryo enters the womb like something seized by an affliction.

verses.text:
शीर्णं परशरीरेण निच्छवीकं शरीरिणम् ।
प्राणिनां प्राणसंरोधे मांसश्लेष्मविचेष्टितम् ॥

meaning.en: A body worn down by another body, stripped of skin, a creature of flesh and phlegm moving when the life-breaths are checked,

verses.text:
निर्दग्धं परदेहेन परदेहं चलाचलम् ।
विनश्यन्तं विनाशान्ते नावि नावमिवाहितम् ॥

meaning.en: burned by another body, a shifting body in another body, perishing at the end of its destruction like a boat placed on a boat.

verses.text:
संगत्या जठरे न्यस्तं रेतोबिन्दुमचेतनम् ।
केन यत्नेन जीवन्तं गर्भं त्वमिह पश्यसि ॥

meaning.en: A senseless drop of semen placed in the womb through union: by what effort do you suppose the embryo lives?

verses.text:
अन्नपानानि जीर्यन्ते यत्र भक्षाश्च भक्षिताः ।
तस्मिन्नेवोदरे गर्भः किं नान्नमिव जीर्यते ॥

meaning.en: In the very belly where food and drink are digested and eaten things consumed, why is the embryo not digested like food?

verses.text:
गर्भमूत्रपुरीषाणां स्वभावनियता गतिः ।
धारणे वा विसर्गे वा न कर्तुर्विद्यते वशः ॥

meaning.en: The movement of the embryo, urine, and feces is fixed by nature; whether retained or released, no doer has control.

verses.text:
स्रवन्ति ह्युदराद्गर्भा जायमानास्तथापरे ।
आगमेन सहान्येषां विनाश उपपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: Some embryos flow away from the womb, others are lost as they are being born, and others perish when they arrive.

verses.text:
एतस्माद्योनिसंबन्धाद्यो जीवन्परिमुच्यते ।
प्रजां च लभते कांचित्पुनर्द्वंद्वेषु मज्जति ॥

meaning.en: He who is released alive from this connection with the womb and gets some child still sinks again into the pairs of opposites.

verses.text:
शतस्य सहजातस्य सप्तमीं दशमीं दशाम् ।
प्राप्नुवन्ति ततः पञ्च न भवन्ति शतायुषः ॥

meaning.en: Of a hundred-year life, a man reaches the seventh and tenth stages; and of those, five do not reach a hundred years.

verses.text:
नाभ्युत्थाने मनुष्याणां योगाः स्युर्नात्र संशयः ।
व्याधिभिश्च विमथ्यन्ते व्यालैः क्षुद्रमृगा इव ॥

meaning.en: Without rising effort people have no accomplishments, there is no doubt of it, yet they are crushed by diseases like small animals by beasts of prey.

verses.text:
व्याधिभिर्भक्ष्यमाणानां त्यजतां विपुलं धनम् ।
वेदनां नापकर्षन्ति यतमानाश्चिकित्सकाः ॥

meaning.en: For those being devoured by diseases, who give up vast wealth, striving physicians cannot remove the pain.

verses.text:
ते चापि निपुणा वैद्याः कुशलाः संभृतौषधाः ।
व्याधिभिः परिकृष्यन्ते मृगा व्याधैरिवार्दिताः ॥

meaning.en: Even those skilled and clever doctors with collected medicines are dragged by illnesses, like deer tormented by hunters.

verses.text:
ते पिबन्तः कषायांश्च सर्पींषि विविधानि च ।
दृश्यन्ते जरया भग्ना नागा नागैरिवोत्तमैः ॥

meaning.en: Even while they drink decoctions and various ghees, they are seen broken by old age, like elephants by superior elephants.

verses.text:
के वा भुवि चिकित्सन्ते रोगार्तान्मृगपक्षिणः ।
श्वापदानि दरिद्रांश्च प्रायो नार्ता भवन्ति ते ॥

meaning.en: Who on earth treats sick beasts and birds, predators and the poor? Mostly they do not become sick.

verses.text:
घोरानपि दुराधर्षान्नृपतीनुग्रतेजसः ।
आक्रम्य रोग आदत्ते पशून्पशुपचो यथा ॥

meaning.en: Disease attacks and seizes even terrible, unassailable kings of fierce splendor, as a butcher takes animals.

verses.text:
इति लोकमनाक्रन्दं मोहशोकपरिप्लुतम् ।
स्रोतसा सहसा क्षिप्तं ह्रियमाणं बलीयसा ॥

meaning.en: So the world, without cry, is flooded with delusion and sorrow, thrown suddenly by the current and carried off by the stronger.

verses.text:
न धनेन न राज्येन नोग्रेण तपसा तथा ।
स्वभावा व्यतिवर्तन्ते ये नियुक्ताः शरीरिषु ॥

meaning.en: Not by wealth, not by kingdom, not by fierce austerity do the natures assigned to embodied beings turn aside.

verses.text:
न म्रियेरन्न जीर्येरन्सर्वे स्युः सर्वकामिकाः ।
नाप्रियं प्रतिपश्येयुरुत्थानस्य फलं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: If they did, none would die or age; all would have all their wishes and never see anything unwelcome as the fruit of effort.

verses.text:
उपर्युपरि लोकस्य सर्वो भवितुमिच्छति ।
यतते च यथाशक्ति न च तद्वर्तते तथा ॥

meaning.en: Everyone wants to be above everyone else in the world and strives as he can, but it does not turn out so.

verses.text:
ऐश्वर्यमदमत्तांश्च मत्तान्मद्यमदेन च ।
अप्रमत्ताः शठाः क्रूरा विक्रान्ताः पर्युपासते ॥

meaning.en: Cunning, cruel, and valiant men, alert, wait on those intoxicated with power and wealth and drunk with liquor.

verses.text:
क्लेशाः प्रतिनिवर्तन्ते केषांचिदसमीक्षिताः ।
स्वं स्वं च पुनरन्येषां न किंचिदभिगम्यते ॥

meaning.en: Troubles turn away from some without being examined; but another's own possessions in turn are not reached.

verses.text:
महच्च फलवैषम्यं दृश्यते कर्मसंधिषु ।
वहन्ति शिबिकामन्ये यान्त्यन्ये शिबिकागताः ॥

meaning.en: There is a great mismatch of results at the meeting of actions: some carry the palanquin, others ride in it.

verses.text:
सर्वेषामृद्धिकामानामन्ये रथपुरःसराः ।
मनुजाश्च शतस्त्रीकाः शतशो विधवाः स्त्रियः ॥

meaning.en: Among all who seek prosperity, some go ahead in chariots; some men have a hundred wives while hundreds of women are widows.

verses.text:
द्वंद्वारामेषु भूतेषु गच्छन्त्येकैकशो नराः ।
इदमन्यत्परं पश्य मात्र मोहं करिष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: Among beings that delight in pairs of opposites, people go one by one. See this other higher thing; do not fall into confusion here.

verses.text:
त्यज धर्ममधर्मं च उभे सत्यानृते त्यज ।
उभे सत्यानृते त्यक्त्वा येन त्यजसि तं त्यज ॥

meaning.en: Give up dharma and adharma, give up truth and falsehood both; having given up both, give up that by which you give them up.

verses.text:
एतत्ते परमं गुह्यमाख्यातमृषिसत्तम ।
येन देवाः परित्यज्य मर्त्यलोकं दिवं गताः ॥

meaning.en: This supreme secret has been told to you, best of sages, by which the gods left the mortal world and went to heaven.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शुकः परमबुद्धिमान् ।
संचिन्त्य मनसा धीरो निश्चयं नाध्यगच्छत ॥

meaning.en: Hearing Narada's words, Shuka, very wise and steady, reflected in his mind but did not reach a decision.

verses.text:
पुत्रदारैर्महान्क्लेशो विद्याम्नाये महाञ्श्रमः ।
किं नु स्याच्छाश्वतं स्थानमल्पक्लेशं महोदयम् ॥

meaning.en: "There is great trouble from sons and wives, and great labor in studying the sacred tradition; what could be an eternal state with little trouble and great rise?"

verses.text:
ततो मुहूर्तं संचिन्त्य निश्चितां गतिमात्मनः ।
परावरज्ञो धर्मस्य परां नैःश्रेयसीं गतिम् ॥

meaning.en: After pondering a moment, he fixed his own course, knowing higher and lower, the supreme path to the highest good of dharma.

verses.text:
कथं त्वहमसंक्लिष्टो गच्छेयं परमां गतिम् ।
नावर्तेयं यथा भूयो योनिसंसारसागरे ॥

meaning.en: "How can I reach the highest goal untroubled, so that I never again return to the ocean of rebirth through wombs?

verses.text:
परं भावं हि काङ्क्षामि यत्र नावर्तते पुनः ।
सर्वसङ्गान्परित्यज्य निश्चितां मनसो गतिम् ॥

meaning.en: I long for the supreme state from which one does not return, giving up all attachments, with the mind's course settled.

verses.text:
तत्र यास्यामि यत्रात्मा शमं मेऽधिगमिष्यति ।
अक्षयश्चाव्ययश्चैव यत्र स्थास्यामि शाश्वतः ॥

meaning.en: I shall go where my self will find peace, where I will stay eternal, undiminishing and unchanging.

verses.text:
न तु योगमृते शक्या प्राप्तुं सा परमा गतिः ।
अवबन्धो हि मुक्तस्य कर्मभिर्नोपपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: That supreme goal cannot be reached without yoga, for the liberated one is not bound by actions.

verses.text:
तस्माद्योगं समास्थाय त्यक्त्वा गृहकलेवरम् ।
वायुभूतः प्रवेक्ष्यामि तेजोराशिं दिवाकरम् ॥

meaning.en: So taking to yoga and leaving this house-body, I shall become wind and enter the sun, that mass of splendor.

verses.text:
न ह्येष क्षयमाप्नोति सोमः सुरगणैर्यथा ।
कम्पितः पतते भूमिं पुनश्चैवाधिरोहति ।
क्षीयते हि सदा सोमः पुनश्चैवाभिपूर्यते ॥

meaning.en: For it never wanes, unlike the moon, which, shaken, falls to earth and climbs again, and always wanes and fills again among the groups of gods.

verses.text:
रविस्तु संतापयति लोकान्रश्मिभिरुल्बणैः ।
सर्वतस्तेज आदत्ते नित्यमक्षयमण्डलः ॥

meaning.en: The sun heats the worlds with its fierce rays and takes in radiance from every side; its orb ever imperishable.

verses.text:
अतो मे रोचते गन्तुमादित्यं दीप्ततेजसम् ।
अत्र वत्स्यामि दुर्धर्षो निःसङ्गेनान्तरात्मना ॥

meaning.en: So it pleases me to go to the blazing sun; there I shall dwell, unassailable, with an inner self unattached.

verses.text:
सूर्यस्य सदने चाहं निक्षिप्येदं कलेवरम् ।
ऋषिभिः सह यास्यामि सौरं तेजोऽतिदुःसहम् ॥

meaning.en: Leaving this body in the sun's abode, I shall go with the sages into the solar radiance, hard to endure.

verses.text:
आपृच्छामि नगान्नागान्गिरीनुर्वीं दिशो दिवम् ।
देवदानवगन्धर्वान्पिशाचोरगराक्षसान् ॥

meaning.en: I take leave of the trees, the elephants, the mountains, the earth, the directions, the sky, the gods, danavas, gandharvas, pishachas, serpents, and rakshasas.

verses.text:
लोकेषु सर्वभूतानि प्रवेक्ष्यामि नसंशयः ।
पश्यन्तु योगवीर्यं मे सर्वे देवाः सहर्षिभिः ॥

meaning.en: I shall enter all beings in the worlds, without doubt; let all the gods and sages see the power of my yoga."

verses.text:
अथानुज्ञाप्य तमृषिं नारदं लोकविश्रुतम् ।
तस्मादनुज्ञां संप्राप्य जगाम पितरं प्रति ॥

meaning.en: Then, taking leave of the world-famous sage Narada and receiving his permission, he went to his father.

verses.text:
सोऽभिवाद्य महात्मानमृषिं द्वैपायनं मुनिम् ।
शुकः प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य कृष्णमापृष्टवान्मुनिः ॥

meaning.en: Shuka greeted the great-souled sage Dvaipayana, circled Krishna in reverence, and took his leave.

verses.text:
श्रुत्वा ऋषिस्तद्वचनं शुकस्य
प्रीतो महात्मा पुनराह चैनम् ।
भो भोः पुत्र स्थीयतां तावदद्य
यावच्चक्षुः प्रीणयामि त्वदर्थम् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing Shuka's words, the great sage, pleased, said to him again: "My son, stay today a little longer, while I feast my eyes on you."

verses.text:
निरपेक्षः शुको भूत्वा निःस्नेहो मुक्तबन्धनः ।
मोक्षमेवानुसंचिन्त्य गमनाय मनो दधे ।
पितरं संपरित्यज्य जगाम द्विजसत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: Shuka, grown indifferent, free of affection and bonds, reflected only on liberation and made up his mind to go. Leaving his father, the best of the twice-born went.
